label.en: Neon lamp NE-2 (holds about 60 V, needs a series resistor)
label.tr: Neon lamba NE-2 (yaklaşık 60 V tutar, seri direnç ister)

note: Glows once the voltage across it passes about 60 V and then holds that voltage, so the current has to be limited from outside (100 k to 220 k at mains).

label.en: Neon indicator lamp 220 V (with series resistor)

note: The panel-mount neon lamp with its resistor built in: connect it straight across the mains. (Across a switching inverter's output the solver may not converge: use it on the mains.)

label.en: 220 V mains inlet with fuse and switch

note: Live (L), neutral (N) and protective earth (PE) as on a Schuko plug. PE is tied to the circuit ground through 1 k; neutral is referenced to ground through 100 M, so a mains circuit needs no extra ground symbol. Double-click switches it.

label.en: Piezo ultrasonic transducer (set fs, C0, Cm, Rm)
label.tr: Piezo ultrasonik transdüser (fs, C0, Cm, Rm ayarlı)

note: Butterworth-Van Dyke model: C0 across the terminals, in parallel with Rm, Lm and Cm in series; Lm follows from fs and Cm. The power in Rm is the sound the transducer radiates.

label.en: Ultrasonic transducer 40 kHz (16 mm, transmitter / receiver)
label.tr: Ultrasonik transdüser 40 kHz (16 mm, verici / alıcı)

note: Typical 16 mm 40 kHz capsule: about 2 nF, series resonance 40 kHz, a few hundred ohms there.

label.en: Langevin power transducer 28 kHz (50 W, probe in water)
label.tr: Langevin güç transdüseri 28 kHz (50 W, probe suda)

note: Bolted Langevin stack, as in ultrasonic probes and cleaners, loaded by water: C0 4.5 nF, resonance 28 kHz. Drive it through an inductor of 1 / (w^2 C0), about 7 mH, to cancel C0.
Bowl-shaped PZT ceramic of the kind used for focused ultrasound, 1 MHz: about 1.5 nF, 40 ohm at resonance.

label.en: Electret microphone capsule (bias through a resistor)

note: The capsule's built-in JFET is a current source: feed it from the supply through 2.2 k to 10 k and take the sound from the + pin through a capacitor. The tone is the sound it hears.

label.en: Variable capacitor (tuning gang, set the value)
Varicap BB910 (capacitance set by a parameter)

note: The capacitance is the parameter; its dependence on the reverse voltage is not simulated.

label.en: Ferrite rod antenna (AM band) with a received station
label.tr: Ferrit çubuk anten (AM bandı), alınan istasyonlu

label.en: Coupling winding turns / tuned winding turns
label.tr: Bağlantı sargısı sarımı / ayarlı sargı sarımı

note: L1-L2 is the tuned winding with the AM station's induced voltage in series; C1-C2 is a few coupling turns. Tune with a variable capacitor from L1 to L2: f = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)).

label.en: ZN414 / TA7642 AM radio chip (3 pins)
label.tr: ZN414 / TA7642 AM radyo entegresi (3 pin)

note: Power it through a 1 k resistor from 1.5 V into the OUT pin; the audio appears on OUT too (take it through a capacitor). Tune the input with a coil and a variable capacitor.
Gain 20; a 10 uF capacitor between GAIN1 and GAIN8 makes it about 190. Keep IN- at ground. The output rests at half the supply, so take it through 220 uF to the speaker.

label.en: TC4427 dual 1.5 A MOSFET gate driver
label.tr: TC4427 çift 1,5 A MOSFET kapı sürücü

note: Non-inverting; 4.5 to 18 V supply. Wire the MOSFET gates to OUTA and OUTB through about 10 ohm.

Astable mode: the outside resistor goes between R and RC, the capacitor between C and RC. Q and /Q are complementary square waves at 1 / (4.4 R C) with 50 % duty; OSC runs at twice that. The trigger, retrigger and reset inputs do nothing in this model.
